Privacy Policy

How we collect, use and protect your personal information.

Folybim Engineering Nigeria Limited respects your privacy. This policy explains how we handle personal information collected through this website, in line with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.

Information we collect

We only collect the information you choose to give us, for example when you complete our contact form or email us:

  • Your name, company, email address and phone number
  • Details of your enquiry or project

How we use your information

  • To respond to your enquiry and prepare quotations
  • To provide and manage the services you request
  • To meet our legal and regulatory obligations

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

Third-party services

Our contact form is processed by Formspree, and our contact page displays a map provided by Google Maps. These providers may process limited technical data in line with their own privacy policies.

How long we keep your information

We keep enquiry details only for as long as needed to respond to you and manage any resulting business relationship, or as required by law.

Your rights

You may ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or object to how we use it. To make a request, email folbimeng@gmail.com.
